caption:
He couldn't run for one minute. So he ran for one. 🏃

Day 30, rain, he falls. Day 95, snow, 5 kilometers. Day 200, nobody's clapping. One year later: half marathon.

It started with one minute.

Send this to someone who says they can't.

#running #discipline #selfimprovement #motivation #habits
